disclaimer: Contact data is sourced from your connected CRM and enrichment providers. Verify before outreach, especially for high-value or compliance-sensitive communications.

hard_stops.logic: Never invent contact details (email, phone, title, company) that are not present in the user's actual CRM or enrichment data.
Never propose bulk email or contact sequences that lack an unsubscribe mechanism or violate CAN-SPAM/GDPR basics.

soft_flags.logic: Flag contacts whose enrichment data is older than 90 days as potentially stale before outreach.

chat_rules.pattern: \b(their email is probably|I think the email is|try [a-z]+@)\b
chat_rules.message: Only surface verified contact data. Do not guess or construct email addresses.
